ray_xattn.doc: seen2scene.futureview.model.RayXAttn: per-ray attention of [V2 ray context + Fourier(direction, origin/extent)] over the 32 sample-point tokens [F0, F1, in-domain flag, s_j, Fourier(2 s_j - 1), t_j / ext_max]; mask = inside the grid; residual added to the V2 ray context; W_o normal(std 0.005), zero bias

inference_precision: bf16 autocast for encoder / ray encoder / ray X-Attn / U-Net; float32 attention softmax, projection, decoding and DistP1 (as V2)
